name: HAMILTON, Garth Russell

headline.note: The official parliamentary biography supplies year-level boundaries for seven consecutive pre-parliament roles from 2007 to 2020, but does not establish substantive full-time status, leave, exact transition dates or overlaps. Earlier work for BHP, Alcan and Parsons Brinckerhoff is undated. Racing Queensland is public-controlled; the other commercial engineering employers are private, while CRC ORE was a nonprofit research collaboration. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Macmahon / Macmahon Underground Pty Ltd, Argyle project
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives the year range. Later reporting identifies Hamilton as project manager for the underground section of Rio Tinto's Argyle Diamond Mine, consistent with the Western Australian mining-project account, but exact project and payroll boundaries, hours and leave remain unavailable. Court judgment supplies full-name match Garth Russell Hamilton as Argyle project manager in November2013 within Macmahon Underground litigation. This identifies project/operating company context; his precise payroll entity, appointment/end and hours remain unproved. Other employees’ contract or medical information is not evidence of Hamilton’s terms.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but the evidence is insufficient for a full-time duration.

career_spells.counting_note: The role title and year range do not by themselves prove a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography supplies role and year range. Queensland legislation continued the Racing Queensland Board as the statutory control body and classified it as a statutory body and unit of public administration, supporting public control. Exact employment boundaries, hours, leave and overlap remain unknown. Historical2018–19 employer report corroborates public control for the relevant period. Removed unrelated CRC project source from this role;2026 consolidated legislation alone was not relied on for historical control.
career_spells.counting_note: Public control is established, but full-time status and exact duration are not.

career_spells.employer: CRC ORE Ltd (Cooperative Research Centre for Optimising Resource Extraction)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives a 2019-2020 Research Coordinator role. A CRC ORE project snapshot names Hamilton as program manager for work timed September 2019-December 2020. The industry-led nonprofit was funded by mining participants, researchers and the Australian Government; funding does not establish government control. Exact payroll dates, hours and leave are unavailable. Additional P2-008 snapshot names him as program manager. Its July2019–December2020 project schedule is not substituted for payroll dates or proof of continued work after election.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit research employment is excluded from the two-sector headline.
